description: This file contains the implementation of the ZoneService, a core service managing geographical zone data, including retrieval by code, association with descriptions, and caching mechanisms for country and language-specific zone lists.

classes.name: ZoneServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ZoneService, providing methods to manage zone entities, fetch zones by country and language with caching, add descriptions to zones, and retrieve zones by code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Zone entity by its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a zone if it doesn't already contain it and updates the zone.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches a list of zones for a specific country and language, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches a map of zones keyed by code for a specific language, using cache for performance.
